speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 28)
question: Where must the mind be cast?
premises: As thus where there, at twelve-end mind should cast.
Moment by moment: of wasted turning strangeness, in days becomes.
inference: Cast at the twelve-end moment by moment, strangeness wears away in days.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 29)
question: What burns?
premises: By time-fire from time-place arisen: own city burnt.
At end calm-shining, then may be.
inference: Burning the city in time-fire ends in calm-shining.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 30)
question: What remains after burning?
premises: Thus world all burnt, having meditated, from fancy.
In non-other mind of man: man-ness supreme may be.
inference: Fancy-burned world leaves only man-ness supreme in the non-other mind.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 31)
question: Where is the supreme manifested?
premises: In own body, world or even minute-minuter things and realities.
Having meditated at end: is manifested supreme.
inference: Meditating the minutest realities in own body manifests the supreme.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 32)
question: What does the weak power do?
premises: Thin and weak power meditated at twelve-range.
Having entered in heart meditating: freed from freedom may win.
inference: Entering heart with the weak power at the twelve-range wins freedom.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 33)
question: What is contemplated in order?
premises: World-course-etc formed, in order all.
Gross-subtle-supreme standing, as long as at end mind-dissolving.
inference: The ordered world-course runs to the end where mind dissolves.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 34)
question: Where does the great rise come from?
premises: Of this, of all, of world at ends everywhere.
By path-procedure reality Śaiva meditated: great rise.
inference: Meditating Śiva-reality by path-procedure at world's ends gives the great rise.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 35)
question: How is the universe voided?
premises: Universe this, great goddess: void-become should think.
Right there and mind merged: then of that merging vessel.
inference: Void-thinking merges the mind — one becomes the vessel of that merging.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 36)
question: Where does gaze rest?
premises: In pot-etc vessel, gaze: wall left, cast well.
At that dissolving in that moment gone: made-of-that may be.
inference: Cast well beyond the wall, at dissolution one becomes made-of-that.

speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 37)
question: What is born when mind dissolves?
premises: In treeless mountain-wall-etc place, gaze cast well.
When dissolved in mind: of turning-wasted is born.
inference: Where mind dissolves, the wasting of turning is born out.
